description: Semantic review of individual units in pdf_corpus_coverage.json. Each entry is bound to the page-text digest it was reviewed against; build_pdf_ledger.py refuses to apply an entry whose unit or digest has changed.

entries.title: Server Side Request Forgery (SSRF)

exact_difference.detail: the unit requires an allowlist for caller-supplied fetch targets and forbids returning the upstream response; the rule adds resolved-address authorization, per-redirect re-authorization, and the DNS-rebinding window

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the rule's address policy is stated for IPv4 and IPv6 ranges the unit does not enumerate; deployments behind egress proxies may need a different enforcement point

entries.title: Arbitrary file read

exact_difference.detail: the unit shows a read path built by concatenating a caller-supplied id onto a root, exploited with ..; the rule states the containment contract that rejects it

entries.remaining_uncertainty: symlink traversal inside the root is stated as a contract item but is platform-dependent to enforce

exact_difference.detail: the unit shows the write-side of the same defect, where an uploaded file name escapes the upload directory; the rule covers read, write, and delete alike

entries.title: Denial of Service (DoS)

exact_difference.detail: the unit describes denial of service through resource exhaustion and notes that blocking the async event loop lets a small number of requests stall a service; the rule adds explicit byte, deadline, and concurrency ceilings

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the rule does not prescribe values; limits are per-route capacity decisions

exact_difference.detail: the unit introduces authenticated encryption as the construction that removes block-cipher and MAC composition footguns; the rule requires an AEAD

entries.title: Common problems and pitfalls with cryptography

exact_difference.detail: the unit states that key management is hard, that AEAD should be preferred, that primitives should not be implemented locally, and that side channels and non-constant-time code defeat correctness testing; the rule states the same contract

entries.remaining_uncertainty: constant-time behaviour cannot be proven by a portable test; the assertion covers the comparison contract, not the generated code

entries.title: The Rust cryptography ecosystem

exact_difference.detail: the unit is a 2021 survey of Rust cryptography crates; crate-by-crate recommendations age out and are not a durable coding contract for this library

entries.remaining_uncertainty: if a future rule names specific crates, it must be re-derived from current advisories rather than this survey

exact_difference.detail: the unit gives the reasons to vendor dependencies (offline builds, privacy, reviewable update diffs) and the repository-size cost, with a private registry as the alternative; the rule states the same trade-off
the unit covers automated auditing of a dependency tree, including advisory scanning; the rules place that in the CI gate and in the admission policy

entries.title: Writing and Running Integration Tests

exact_difference.detail: the unit establishes POSIX exit status (0 success, non-zero failure) and black-box testing of the built binary; the rules add stream routing, broken-pipe handling, and the stdin conventions

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the rules describe the pattern with std process APIs; the unit uses assert_cmd, which is named in the rule text but not depended on

exact_difference.detail: the unit documents the convention that a file argument of - means standard input, and that absent arguments read stdin; the rule states it as contract
the unit collects the testing practices used across the book's programs, including golden output and temporary directories; the rule states them as a contract

entries.title: Borrowing and Lifetimes

exact_difference.detail: the unit derives variance from subtyping, shows that &mut T is invariant in T, and shows the two-lifetime remedy for a struct holding &'a mut &'b str; the rule states that contract

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the PhantomData guidance in the rule is stated more briefly than the unit's later treatment of pointer types

exact_difference.detail: the unit recommends auditing dependencies with cargo-deny and cargo-audit for advisories, duplicate major versions, unmaintained crates, and license policy; the rule states the same admission and audit policy

entries.title: Versioning

exact_difference.detail: the unit covers Cargo semantic versioning, the MSRV minor-bump technique, minimal dependency versions, changelogs, and prerelease versioning between releases; the rule states each as contract

entries.remaining_uncertainty: minimal-version resolution remains an unstable Cargo flag, so the rule's verification step depends on nightly

entries.title: Additional Testing Tools

exact_difference.detail: the unit covers fuzzing, property testing, Miri, Loom, and benchmark variance; the mapped rules state each, with fuzzing and sanitizers newly added

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the unit is an early-access edition; tool names were re-checked against current releases before the rules were written

exact_difference.detail: the unit requires running unsafe code through Miri and sanitizers in CI, notes that both only observe executed paths, and asks for assertions in unsafe code; the rules state the same

entries.title: Sane Concurrency

exact_difference.detail: the unit covers ThreadSanitizer for larger concurrent tests, its constant-factor overhead, and its nightly -Zsanitizer=thread requirement; the rule states it

entries.remaining_uncertainty: sanitizer availability is target-specific, which the rule notes but cannot enumerate

entries.title: Protect Your Secrets - secrecy

exact_difference.detail: the unit introduces a secret wrapper because instrumentation captures arguments by default, and identifies the masked Debug implementation as the key property, with wiping as a nice-to-have; the rule states that contract

entries.remaining_uncertainty: the rule shows a local wrapper so the example compiles without the crate; production use should take the maintained crate

exact_difference.detail: the unit distinguishes the sources of time available to a process, including the real-time clock and the operating system's system clock
the unit defines absolute time, the system clock and its jumps, monotonicity, and steady clocks with equal-length seconds suited to measuring durations; the rule states which clock each use requires

the unit warns that setting the system clock makes it jump and can destabilize applications that expect monotonically increasing time; the rule turns that into a type-level split between measurement and timestamps

entries.title: 9.9 clock v0.1.3: Resolving differences between clocks with the Network Time Protocol (NTP)

exact_difference.detail: the unit builds an NTP client that adjusts the local clock toward server time, which is the mechanism that makes wall-clock differences unreliable for measurement
